notes:
**Playback gate** - by default the loop now plays only while your DAW channel sends MPE Bender a note. Put a note in the pattern to gate the loop for that span (any pitch; the note itself is silent). A disabled or empty channel stays quiet. Turn on **Free run** on the toolbar to run the loop with the transport regardless. The standalone defaults to Free run.

**More per-note bends** - MPE member channels now go up to **15** (the MPE maximum), so 15 notes can bend independently at once.

**Piano-roll navigation**
- mouse wheel = scroll vertically, Shift+wheel = scroll horizontally
- Ctrl+wheel = zoom horizontally, Ctrl+Shift+wheel = zoom vertically, trackpad pinch = both

**Editing**
- Ctrl+B = duplicate the selection right after itself
- Up / Down arrow move the selection by a semitone (a scale degree with Snap on); Ctrl+Up / Down by an octave
- Snap-to-scale also applies to paste

**Other**
- Fullscreen toggle in the tab bar
- fixed both tab buttons showing as active
- Snap is now a clearly visible toggle button
- prodcoldie is the plugin vendor name; small watermark in the roll
